correctness.rationale: Every nonzero ternary cubic over F3 is represented by a normalized projective coefficient vector (29524 forms). A 25-orbit PGL3(F3) reduction and exact three-chart Jacobian Groebner ideal test give 10 smooth orbits containing exactly 16848 projective smooth cubic forms. Independently implemented finite group-orbit enumeration, exact SymPy Groebner smoothness tests of the 25 representatives, and a complete separate 16,848×16,848 vectorized ordered-generator-pair enumeration with both F+G and F+2G smooth. Raw counts by rational base cardinality: 30932928,31817448,17926272,5997888,673920 for 0..4; all larger zero. Each pencil has exactly 12 ordered projective generator pairs, yielding histogram 2577744,2651454,1493856,499824,56160 and total 7279038. Rational point incidence sum across four members is 13+3b; Hasse gives b≤5 but exhaustive exact census sharpens to b≤4. Finite-field completeness is proven for the entire stated q=3 population; no claim of geometric smoothness of every algebraic-closure member.
